title: Clown Mask
description: Change your pumpkin into a smiling clown mask.
body:
**Description**
Clown Mask is a resource pack where you can change your pumpkin mask into a clown mask and the visuals will be updated.

**Features**

Update Visual for Curved Pumpkin

Anvil System (Use Curved Pumpkin)

**Installation Guide**
Download and install Minecraft Optifine for version 1.20.1
Download the Long Sword mod .Zip file
Place the downloaded .Zip file into your Resource Packs folder
Launch Minecraft and go to Options > Resource Packs
Enable the Long Sword resource pack
Enjoy the new Long Sword visuals in your game!
